title: Verified personal notification email
description: Users can add, verify, replace or remove their notification email in workspace notification settings without changing sign-in identities. Codes expire after 15 minutes, with resend and attempt limits. Verification enables personal email notifications for that workspace. Existing account email destinations remain supported; SMTP configuration and current repository access are required for delivery. Email contents remain generic links to Preflyt. Verification uses a compact modal; delivery is queued immediately and retried in the background without waiting for SMTP.
upgrade: Back up the database, apply both additive personal email and verification outbox migrations, regenerate Prisma and recreate matching API, worker and web versions. Existing SMTP settings, queue and CONFIGURATION_ENCRYPTION_KEY are reused; API and worker need the same encryption key.
